description: AI-powered product where the AI is the core experience. Industry brain defines the domain the AI operates in. This core defines how AI interaction, generation, and configuration work.

three_js.description: Multi-layer neural network — nodes connected by edges, signal pulses travel along connections. Nodes activate and dim. Technical and precise.
three_js.avoid: no status pills, no hero-stat-line, no ticker strips

relationships: Message is either from User or from AI
Generation is the AI output from a Message or Prompt
Prompt is a saved input created by User
Model is the AI model configuration — version, temperature, context length
Usage tracks tokens consumed and cost per User or Organisation
APIKey belongs to User or Organisation — grants programmatic access
Project groups Conversations by topic or purpose
Template is a reusable Prompt created by User
Output is a saved Generation — image, text, code, or file
Feedback belongs to Message — thumbs up or down plus optional note

layout.notes: Input is the entire product. It must always be immediately visible, never scrolled off screen. Conversation history in left sidebar on desktop and iPad — always accessible without leaving current conversation.

avoid: Never show a loading spinner during AI streaming — show the text as it arrives
Never use photography or illustration in core product screens — SVG and CSS only
Never truncate AI responses — always show full output with scroll
Never use a modal for conversation history — sidebar panel only
Never auto-submit on enter without shift+enter for new line — developers expect this
Never show token count or technical API details to non-developer users
Never use a generic chat bubble for AI responses — use a distinct visual treatment
Never disable the input while AI is streaming — allow queue or interrupt
enforce: Streaming output — text appears token by token, never all at once
Stop generation button always visible during streaming
Copy button appears on hover or tap of any AI message — never requires selecting text
Code blocks always syntax highlighted — language label top right
Markdown rendered in AI responses — headers, bold, lists, not raw symbols
Conversation history searchable — search by keyword, not just scroll
Usage counter visible — credits remaining or message count — before user hits limit
Model indicator always visible — user must always know what model generated the response

empty_states.ui: Centred prompt area. Greeting: 'What can I help you build today?' Below: 3-4 example prompts as clickable chips. Input bar ready and focused.
Message bubble illustration. Message: 'No conversations yet'. Sub: 'Your conversations will appear here'. CTA points to new conversation.
Bookmark illustration. Message: 'Nothing saved yet'. Instruction: 'Click the bookmark icon on any AI response to save it'.

loading_states.ui: User message appears immediately. AI response area shows animated dots (typing indicator) for up to 2 seconds before first token streams. Never blank space.
Skeleton conversation rows — title line, timestamp, preview line. 5 rows shimmer.
Credit balance shows skeleton number. Chart skeleton. History table skeleton rows.

error_flows.ui: AI message area shows: 'Something went wrong. Please try again.' Retry button inline in the message thread. Input re-enabled immediately. Conversation not lost.
Soft limit warning at 80%: 'You have X credits remaining'. Hard limit: input disabled. Message: 'You've used all your credits'. Upgrade CTA prominent. Do not lose conversation.
AI response: clear explanation of why it can't help with that specific request. Suggest alternative framing. Never cryptic 'request blocked' message.
Warning before sending: 'This conversation is very long. Older context may be lost.' Option to start new conversation or continue. User decides.

edge_cases.ui: Response renders in full with scroll. Table of contents offered for structured long responses. Copy all button. Download as markdown option.

edge_cases.case: Code in response longer than viewport
edge_cases.ui: Code block scrollable horizontally. Never wrap code — horizontal scroll preserves formatting. Copy code button always visible.
Image displayed inline in conversation. Download button. Regenerate button. Prompt used shown below image. Never just a URL.
Streaming stops. Partial response shown with warning: 'Response interrupted'. Retry button. Partial content preserved — not erased.
